$comment: Tier 2 of the design system: what a thing is made of, as expressions over tier 1 (schemas/design-scale, schemas/type-scale). webviews/scripts/pages/gen-design-scale.mjs writes each field as a --role-<name>-<field> variable into the design-scale block of webviews/src/pages/shared/desktop.css, as calc() over the --ds-* variables so Settings' page density and the host's button corner reach it, and lists the resolved pixels in webviews/src/ui/designTokens.generated.ts. `bun run check:design-scale` fails when the block drifts. A component reads --role-* only. The corner rule (hq docs/design/design-debate-2026-11-22.md, Instrument v0.1): corner = min(inner corner + inset, floor4(shortest height / 3)), so a thin surface never turns into a capsule. Names: space.N, control.NAME, radius.NAME and text.NAME.lineHeight are tier 1; ROLE.FIELD is another role; self.FIELD is this role, so a role that is `like` another rebinds it. floor4(x) rounds down to the 4 px grid.

roles.name: control
roles.for: a button, field or chip: the tab's corner (Lawrence 2026-11-12, buttons round as tabs)

roles.name: row
roles.for: a menu or list row's highlight, inside a floating surface's inset

roles.name: floating
roles.for: anything that floats over the page: one corner, one inset (the brief's control corner + inset is 12, Leo's pending popup-corner call; flip `row.radius` to `control.radius` here)

roles.name: popover
roles.for: a popover with rows or a form

roles.name: tooltip
roles.for: a one-line label with a shortcut hint

roles.name: toast
roles.for: a notice in the stack: one line of text at an 8 px inset, about 34 px tall

roles.name: dialog
roles.for: a modal dialog: its buttons at the inset, so the corner is the button's plus the inset
